verdicts.reason: Endpoint absent: www/command.php does not exist in this 2.05b03 (2010-11-23) build - httpd maps / to /www and dispatches .php via External CGI /sbin/atp only for existing files (missing -> 404 via faketoreal/status table), the atp engine contains no cmd/command handling, and all companion daemons (hnap /HNAP1, upnpdev SSDP:1900, upnpkits TCP:49152, widget, submit, scheduled) were checked and expose no cmd POST parameter; PoC-confirmed vulnerable versions (2.12/2.13, 2012) postdate this build, i.e. the vulnerable page was introduced in later firmware.

grep -rn '$cmd'/'cmd=' in www etc htdocs -> only internal UPnP iptables builders and usockc scheduler messages from rgdb nodes, not attacker-controllable via POST cmd
verdicts.reason: Identical endpoint/parameter as CVE-2013-10069 and equally absent: www/command.php does not exist in this 2.05b03 build, atp engine and all companion daemons (hnap/upnpdev/upnpkits/widget/submit/scheduled) have no cmd POST parameter handling, so the described unauthenticated command-injection path cannot exist in this firmware.
